No labels, panels, text captions, floor, shadows, background, motion streaks or duplicated body parts. Truly transparent alpha.
Image 1 is the identity/style reference: chibi blue gradient wavy hair, ahoge, blue-white whale ears and blue whale tail, orange asterisk hair clip, cream hoodie with caramel bow and orange sleeve asterisks, small flower patch on pocket, tan pleated skirt and white frill, white flower legwarmers, brown Mary Jane shoes. Use it ONLY to understand the action poses, sequencing and interaction; do NOT copy its maid outfit, hairstyle proportions, labels, background or panel design. The replacement character must wear Image 1's cream hoodie, orange details and Claude badge. Leave MORE empty margin than the previous sheets: character occupies only central 75% of EACH cell, ahoge, hands, tail and shoes never touch cell edges.Action 点击回应-傲娇生气.
